questions.text: I naturally enjoy planning, structuring and organising things.
I feel comfortable managing timelines, resources and responsibilities.
I prefer clarity, systems and step-by-step processes.
I enjoy studying patterns, trends or hidden causes behind situations.
I often make decisions by analysing facts before acting.
I like solving complex problems through logic and research.
I enjoy expressing ideas, teaching, speaking or persuading others.
People often come to me because I can explain things clearly.
I feel energised when I can influence, present or connect with people.
I enjoy generating new ideas, concepts or possibilities.
I prefer work that allows imagination, innovation or visual thinking.
I often see alternative ways to approach a problem.

archetypes.name: Innovation Thinker
archetypes.essence: Invents smart solutions to hard problems

snapshot.headline: Your Talent Tree
snapshot.balancedMessage: Your four branches are closely matched, so no single branch dominates yet. You may flex between them more easily than most people.
snapshot.coDominantTemplate: Your {a} and {b} branches are equally strong.
snapshot.ctaSubcopy: Your strengths show how you naturally operate. Now let's explore where those strengths could have the greatest meaning and value.

observations.organiser: You instinctively bring order to moving parts, and people can rely on you to keep track of what matters.
observations.analyst: You look past the surface of a situation, which means you usually spot the real issue before others do.
observations.communicator: You turn understanding into shared understanding, which is what makes a plan actually travel.
observations.creative: You generate options where others see constraints, which opens paths nobody had considered yet.
